tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The window background behind everything (Tuff `background`). The top bar and sidebar sit directly on it.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Same value as bg: the surface the sidebar and top bar text sit on. Checked for fg, fg-2, fg-3.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: The Shell: a tray one step off the window that holds a Panel. In light it is grey, in dark it is lighter than the window (Tuff `surface`).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: The Panel: the content surface inside a Shell. Whiter than the shell in light, darker (recessed) in dark (Tuff `surface-inset`). Thread messages, cards and forms sit here.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips: one step above the shell (Tuff `surface-raised`). Always with shadow-menu or shadow-tip.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: The Inset well: foreground at 4-5%. Tool rows, code, payloads, tags, switch tracks. Sits on a panel or a shell.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on rows and quiet buttons, laid over any surface.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: The selected sidebar row and the pressed state of a quiet button.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline: foreground at 7% (light) and white at 6% (dark), as in Tuff `border`. Row dividers and card rings. Decorative, not a control edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Composer edge at rest, Kbd outline, approval card ring.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: an off toggle, a checkbox. Holds 3:1 on bg, card and panel.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface.

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, menu icons, agent notes.

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Metadata: times, counts, the step ledger, placeholders. 4.5:1 on bg, card, panel, raised and hover in both themes (Tuff `muted-foreground` darkened a step in light mode to pass).

tokens.name: fg-4
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and the idle thread dot only. Fails 4.5:1 by design; never for text someone must read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent (Cauldron ember; Tuff's own is blue #0071e3 / #0a84ff). Primary button, focus ring, needs-you dot, current stage. One primary per view.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the needs-you row. Never a fill for buttons.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring at 2px offset (Tuff: brand at 55-60%; here solid for 3:1).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Passed checks and the + side of a diff. Done states use fg and a check, not ok. Dark value is Tuff positive.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Context over 80%, budget near its cap, an expiring approval. Dark value is Tuff warning.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Failed runs and tool calls, destructive actions, the - side of a diff. Always with a word or an x glyph. Dark value is Tuff negative.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Danger button rest fill and the failed tool row's band.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Behind a warn label in a meter or approval.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Added lines in a diff.

tokens.name: diff-del
tokens.usage: Removed lines in a diff.

tokens.name: agent-1
tokens.usage: Agent identity colour 1: the flat avatar figure and the agent's tab dot. People keep colour; never use for UI state.

tokens.usage: Agent identity colour 2: the flat avatar figure and the agent's tab dot. People keep colour; never use for UI state.

families.sans: Geist, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: Geist, "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "Geist Mono", "Cascadia Mono", "SF Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Section labels in the sidebar and menus. Sentence case by default; never uppercase body text.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Times, counts, second lines of rows, the step ledger. Tabular numerals on.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Control labels inside the composer foot, tags in sans, tooltips.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Plan a change, ask a question or hand a task to an agent.
styles.usage: Default UI text: rows, menus, buttons, messages.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Unread thread titles, card titles, the selected tab.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: The gateway now refuses a write outside the worktree.
styles.usage: Agent prose in the thread column. Max 72ch.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and dialog titles. One per card.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Page headings in Settings and empty states.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: First-run and zero-state only. Never more than once on screen.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Code, payloads, terminal blocks, diff lines.

styles.name: mono-tag
styles.usage: Identifiers in tags: models, branches, file names, tool names.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: segmented switch padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside small controls; menu padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; tag padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Row padding, icon to label in rows, card-to-card gap in the frame.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Card padding, window margins, gap between stacked cards in a thread.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding in Settings and dialogs.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Thread column side padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between message groups.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Empty-state block spacing.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: First-run top offset.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: The window and the composer's outer shell (R + 4).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, tabs, menus, the composer body: the anchor value (R).

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, rows, chips, tool rows, tooltips (R1).

tokens.name: radius-inner
tokens.usage: Anything inside a padded box: tags, Kbd, switch segments (R2).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Circles only: avatars, status dots, the send button. Never pills on text.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers. The ring is part of the shadow; add no border.

tokens.name: shadow-tip
tokens.usage: Tooltips and the selected segment of a segmented switch.

tokens.name: shadow-box
tokens.usage: The composer only. Cards never take a shadow: depth comes from frame, card, inset.

size.note: Control and row heights in px.

tokens.name: size-tag
tokens.usage: Tag and Kbd height.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, icon buttons in dense rows, switch segments.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Default button, icon button, sidebar row, menu item.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Agent tabs, tool rows, composer foot controls.

tokens.name: size-row-2
tokens.usage: Two-line thread row.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Lucide icons in controls, stroke 1.75.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside tool rows and status labels, stroke 2.

duration.note: Motion durations. Exits are faster than entrances; nothing bounces.

tokens.name: dur-swap
tokens.usage: Send and Stop swap, hover colour changes.

tokens.name: dur-exit
tokens.usage: Menus and tooltips leaving.

tokens.name: dur-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and tooltips arriving; 25ms stagger per item.

tokens.name: dur-panel
tokens.usage: Drawer panel content switch, card expand.

tokens.name: dur-layout
tokens.usage: Sidebar, drawer and split opening or closing.

tokens.name: dur-reduced
tokens.usage: The single cross-fade used when the OS asks for less motion.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Every layout move: fast start, long settle.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Fades and menus.
